value: The search resumes with Prospector Ironboot, who sends the seeker after the remaining tablets of Mosh'aru. The account now expands beyond the first pair: six tablets form the record under pursuit. Their collection is a quest objective, while the meanings attributed to them must still be read through the words of the characters who interpret them.
editorNote: Original paraphrase. Scene order follows quest-chain order and does not assert exact date or unsupported causal links. Secondary locators and original-client limits are recorded in the research packet.
